summary: The customer was furious that his bill increased by fifty dollars instead of decreasing after a previous plan change, and that he was charged extra for international roaming despite being told it was free. The agent investigated, offered various solutions including a credit and supervisor override, and ultimately secured a permanent promotional discount matching the original quote along with a refund of the disputed charge, resolving the issue to the customer's satisfaction.

evidence.text: Let me consult with my supervisor to see if we can override the system requirements for this promotion.
evidence.speaker: Agent

commitments.description: Consult with supervisor regarding a system override for the promotion.
Return shortly after consulting the supervisor.

evidence.text: The corrected rate will reflect on your next billing cycle, and I have successfully credited the disputed forty-five dollars back to your card today.
evidence.speaker: Agent

evidence.text: I sincerely apologize for the long wait time and any frustration it has caused.
evidence.speaker: Agent

rubric_scores.justification: The agent maintained a calm, polite, and professional demeanor throughout the call, even when confronted with an angry customer.

evidence.text: I completely recognize how misleading that must have felt, and I apologize that the terms of the promotion weren't communicated clearly to you.

rubric_scores.justification: The agent repeatedly validated the customer's feelings and showed genuine understanding of the frustration caused.

evidence.text: I spoke with my supervisor, and because of your long-standing history with us, we have authorized a permanent promotional discount matching the price you were quoted.
evidence.speaker: Agent

rubric_scores.justification: The agent successfully resolved the issue by getting supervisor approval for the permanent discount and refunding the disputed charge.

rubric_scores.justification: The agent correctly identified the terms of the promotion and accurately navigated the system to apply the correct fix.
